title: There is no "save as" dialogua when using Zoomit screen recording
next_action: Approve the ZoomIt finalization design and request the option-specific failure evidence.

judgment.rationale: The Ctrl+5 reproduction is concrete: recording starts, the border disappears on stop, but no Save As or MP4 appears. The archive does not identify whether capture, finalization, audio, filesystem, or dialog handoff failed.
evidence: Ctrl+5 starts recording and the second Ctrl+5 removes the border.
No Save As dialog or MP4 is produced.
The issue reports a company PC and possible policy involvement.
No linked PR or existing fix is present.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve focused finalization/error-path work while requesting recording options and a fresh failure-time report.

fix_assessment.rationale: No public open or merged fix covers this ZoomIt recording symptom.

proposed_fixes.title: Preserve and diagnose ZoomIt recording finalization-to-save handoff
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: recording stop reaches asynchronous finalization but an exception or failed media operation prevents StartRecordingAsync from reaching ShowSaveDialogWithTrim.
plan: Log the finalization stage and HRESULT for capture, audio, file, and UI-thread handoff failures.
Ensure valid recordings reach Save As, while invalid recordings show an explicit error and clean up safely.
Test MP4/GIF, audio, webcam, cancellation, and no-frame paths.
verification: Repeat Ctrl+5 and verify Save As appears with a playable selected output.
Repeat with audio and webcam options enabled and disabled.
Verify cancellation and failed finalization do not silently discard valid recordings.

confidence.rationale: The completion/save boundary matches the symptom, but the archive does not identify the failing operation.

issue_context.summary: ZoomIt recording stops visually but produces neither Save As nor an MP4.
known_information: Affected version is 0.101.2362 from Microsoft Store.
The yellow border appears and disappears as expected.
The reporter is not running as administrator on a company PC.
A report ZIP is attached but contains no matching recording-session failure evidence.
inferences: The stop path likely runs, but media finalization or UI handoff is not proven.
Audio, webcam, codec, filesystem, or COM/UI-thread behavior could be causal.
issue_context.analysis: The source symbols are identifiable enough for a focused design, but the plan remains red until one failure-time trace distinguishes the finalization branches.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the complete issue body and absence of comments.
Focused source paths are Zoomit.cpp StartRecordingAsync and VideoRecordingSession.cpp StartAsync/ShowSaveDialogWithTrim.
No linked fix or competing public implementation was found.

information_gaps.information: Recording format and microphone, system-audio, and webcam-overlay settings.
information_gaps.why_needed: Identifies which capture/finalization branches are active.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply with the selected format and enabled state of each option.

information_gaps.information: Fresh diagnostic immediately after one failed Ctrl+5 stop.
information_gaps.why_needed: The existing archive does not identify capture, finalization, or save-dialog failure.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: After reproducing, add `/bugreport` immediately and attach the generated ZIP.

design.root_cause: Unconfirmed failure before the asynchronous recording workflow reaches ShowSaveDialogWithTrim.
evidence: The border disappears but no dialog or file appears.
StartRecordingAsync reaches ShowSaveDialogWithTrim only after session completion and UI-thread handoff.
The supplied report lacks a matching recording event.

affected_files.purpose: Recording setup, stop completion, cleanup, and Save As transition.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: Capture/finalization errors can prevent the Save As handoff without a sufficiently visible stage-specific result.
implementation_steps.change: Add stage/HRESULT diagnostics and one explicit cleanup/error path after a valid stop.
implementation_steps.code_block: try { co_await session->StartAsync(); } catch (hresult_error e) { log(stage, e.code()); cleanup(); show_error(); co_return; } co_await uiThread; ShowSaveDialogWithTrim();
edge_cases: Do not delete a file while a writer owns it.
Do not show Save As for a no-frame recording.
tests: MP4 with audio/webcam off and on.
No-frame and Save As cancellation paths.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: Finalization and trim failures can be indistinguishable from cancellation.
implementation_steps.change: Return explicit success, cancellation, or failure while retaining the temporary file until ownership is resolved.
implementation_steps.code_block: result = Finalize(); if (result.failed) return failure(result.error); return ShowSaveDialogWithTrim();
edge_cases: Do not re-trim an already rendered file.
tests: Failure and cancellation clean up correctly.

verify: Build ZoomIt using the existing PowerToys workflow.
Repeat Ctrl+5 with option combinations and confirm Save As or an explicit error.
Collect a fresh report after any remaining failure.
risks: Capture, audio, COM, and UI-thread cleanup ordering can cause file locks or deadlocks.
alternatives: Disable audio/webcam by default; rejected without evidence.
Always show Save As after the border disappears; rejected because an invalid recording must not be saved.

comment.body:
Thanks for the report. To resolve the recorded uncertainty, please provide:

1. Recording format and microphone, system-audio, and webcam-overlay settings. Collection: Reply with the selected format and enabled state of each option.
2. Fresh diagnostic immediately after one failed Ctrl+5 stop. Collection: After reproducing, add `/bugreport` immediately and attach the generated ZIP.
